name: The Way of the Weaponsmith

angles.text: As a blacksmith choosing weapon crafting over armor, this trial opens the way to forging arms for the champions of Azeroth.

faq.answer: Ironus demands a display of skill before inducting any smith into the craft of weapon making.
You must craft four Moonsteel Broadswords, four Massive Iron Axes, two Heavy Mithril Axes, and two Big Black Maces.
faq.q: What must you forge to become a weaponsmith?

faq.answer: Weaponsmiths supply fighters and adventurers with exceptional arms, earning great coin despite the heavy labor and choking forge smoke.
The work demands grueling hours over the anvil, risking sore backs and ash-filled lungs to satisfy constant requests from travelers.

sections.body: Ironus promises that those who fashion fine arms stand to gain mountains of gold. Adventurers from across the world seek out skilled weapon crafters, keeping every anvil ringing day and night. Proving your worth takes more than words, and you are called upon to shape swords, axes, and heavy maces from solid steel and dark iron.
sections.title: The Anvil and the Coin

summary: Ironus offers you a path into weaponsmithing, where fine craftsmanship brings both heavy labor and immense wealth. To earn a place among the masters of the craft, you must hammer out an array of blades, axes, and maces at the anvil.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Way of the Weaponsmith
